listing.original_game_title: ICO (ICO & Shadow of the Colossus Collection)
listing.summary: Upstream reports the title, opening and gameplay controls at 30 FPS. Long sessions have not been tried. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PlayStation 3 collection disc dump. The exact serial and revision are not confirmed here; check pipeline/ico_profile.json before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow alpha 0.2.3 Setup.exe with your own disc and RPCS3 decryption. It recompiles the game locally.

warnings: Upstream reports the title, opening and gameplay controls at 30 FPS. Long sessions have not been tried.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
